newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Turkmen leader in Russia for two-day visit.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen leader in Russia for two-day visit.

text.p: Turkmenistan President Samarmurat Niyazov arrived in Moscow on Monday for two days of talks on economic cooperation and the situation in Afghanistan, Russian news agencies said.
Niyazov and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin discussed deliveries of Turkmen gas to Russia and exploitation of the Caspian Sea.

Niyazov did not attend a meeting between Russia and four ex-Soviet Central Asian republics in the Kazakh capital Almaty earlier this month to discuss the situation in Afghanistan, declaring himself neutral.

He is likely to discuss Afghanistan on Tuesday with the Russian President Boris Yeltsin at a sanatorium outside Moscow where the 65-year-old Russian leader is preparing for open-heart surgery later this year.
Yeltsin is also scheduled to have a regular Tuesday meeting with Chernomyrdin, the agencies said.
Russian Public Television reported that Uzbek leader Islam Karimov was also expected in Moscow on Tuesday. There was no independent confirmation.
